cards.name: Fidget Spinner
cards.caption: Spin to win (nothing)
cards.flavor: 2017: in every pocket and every classroom. Teachers still have nightmares.
cards.art: Three-lobed fidget spinner with a cheeky face on the center bearing, motion-blur arcs around it, one sweat drop. Background: bright yellow. Colors: electric blue, yellow, white, black.

cards.name: OK Boomerang
cards.caption: OK boomer
cards.flavor: 2019's two-word comeback, now a boomerang that always comes back around.
cards.art: Wooden boomerang with a smug half-lidded face mid-spin, dotted curved flight path looping back toward it. Background: retro orange-to-pink sunset. Colors: wood tan, orange, pink, black.

cards.name: Dancing Hot Dog
cards.caption: Look at him go
cards.flavor: 2017: a dancing hot dog lens crashed every selfie. Still the best dancer online.
cards.art: Hot dog in a bun with a mustard zigzag, tiny headphones, stubby arms in a disco pose, one leg kicked high. Background: pastel blue with sparkles. Colors: bun tan, sausage red, mustard yellow, sky blue.

cards.name: Croissant Panic
cards.caption: I COULDA DROPPED IT!!
cards.flavor: Vine, 2015: someone almost drops their croissant and the outrage is legendary.
cards.art: Golden croissant with stick arms hugging itself, huge shocked eyes, screaming mouth, shaking motion lines, a blurry sneaker whooshing past. Background: café pink. Colors: golden yellow, cream, pink, black.

cards.name: Moth Lamp
cards.caption: Brother, may I have lamp
cards.flavor: 2018: a moth's forbidden love for lamps became the internet's purest obsession.
cards.art: Fluffy cream moth with huge round black eyes and feathery antennae hugging a glowing table lamp, little hearts floating. Background: dark navy night. Colors: cream, warm yellow, navy, black.

cards.name: Totally Chickens
cards.caption: Look at all those chickens
cards.flavor: 2016 Vine: a confident narrator, a pond full of geese, and zero chickens.
cards.art: Five white-and-gray geese in a row by a pond, each wearing a tiny fake paper chicken comb, side-eyeing the viewer. Background: green grass and blue pond. Colors: white, gray, orange, green, blue.

cards.name: Mr. Skeltal
cards.caption: Doot doot
cards.flavor: Good bones and calcium for all: 2014's trumpet skeleton. Thank Mr. Skeltal.
cards.art: Grinning cartoon skeleton in a tiny top hat blowing a brass trumpet, 'doot' music notes, a milk carton at its feet. Background: purple. Colors: bone white, brass gold, purple, black.

cards.name: Galaxy Brain
cards.caption: Big brain time
cards.flavor: 2017's expanding-brain chart: each idea dumber, each brain glowier.
cards.art: Pink brain filled with stars and a swirling galaxy, radiating cosmic light rays, tiny smug face. Background: deep space nebula. Colors: pink, cyan, purple, white.

cards.name: Area 51 Runner
cards.caption: They can't stop all of us
cards.flavor: 2019: two million RSVP'd to storm Area 51 arms-back. A tiny crowd actually went.
cards.art: Faceless runner in a tinfoil hat sprinting with both arms stretched straight back, motion lines, a generic 'KEEP OUT' sign and cacti. Background: orange desert dusk. Colors: silver, sand orange, purple sky, black.

cards.name: Road Work Ahead
cards.caption: I sure hope it does
cards.flavor: 2016 Vine: a driver reads a road sign and delivers the decade's greatest pun.
cards.art: Orange diamond road sign with a goofy grin and tiny arms giving a thumbs-up on the road shoulder, traffic cones beside it. Background: bright blue sky. Colors: safety orange, black, asphalt gray, sky blue.

cards.name: Dat Boi
cards.caption: Here come dat boi!
cards.flavor: 2016: a frog on a unicycle. Nobody knows why. Everybody knows the greeting.
cards.art: Cheerful green frog riding a red unicycle, one webbed hand waving, big grin, pedaling motion lines. Background: sunny yellow. Colors: frog green, red, yellow, white.

cards.name: Such Shibe
cards.caption: Much wow. Very pack.
cards.flavor: 2013's Doge: a side-eyeing Shiba plus floating thoughts. Wow. To the moon.
cards.art: Tan-and-cream Shiba Inu sitting with body turned, side-eyeing the viewer with raised brows, scattered multicolor floating words ('wow', 'such', 'very'). Background: light gray. Colors: shiba orange, cream, magenta, lime, cyan.
